gloss: to fold back; to turn back; to call back

definitions.gloss: to fold back; to turn up
definitions.explanation: To fold something back on itself, such as a hem or edge of fabric or paper.

definitions.gloss: to turn back; to retrace one's steps
definitions.explanation: To reverse direction and go back the way one came.

definitions.gloss: to call back; to reply promptly
definitions.explanation: To return a phone call or respond to a message. Very common in business contexts.

examples.english: I'm wearing my pants with the hems rolled up a little.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}して⟦{目印|めじるし}→目印：15923_mejirushi⟧にした。
examples.english: I folded back the edge of the paper as a bookmark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: To turn back at the summit.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}→折り返し地点：19047_orikaeshichiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the marathon's turnaround point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{折|お}り{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: It started raining on the way, so I turned back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し→折り返し：10628_orikaeshi⟧お⟦{電話|でんわ}します→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: The person in charge will get back to you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留守番|るすばん}{電話|でんわ}→留守番電話：15878_rusubandenwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: There was a message on the answering machine, so I called back.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧ (to fold) + ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to return). The physical meaning of folding back extends metaphorically to turning around and to returning communication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{電話|でんわ}する→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧: to call back
- {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to get back in touch
- ⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}→折り返し地点：19047_orikaeshichiten⟧: turnaround point
- ⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}す: to fold back the hem

USAGE:
The adverbial form ⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し→折り返し：10628_orikaeshi⟧ (immediately, in return) is extremely common in business Japanese, especially in phone conversations: ⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し→折り返し：10628_orikaeshi⟧お⟦{電話|でんわ}します→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧ (I'll call you right back). This is one of the most important business phrases for learners to know.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive in sense 1 (folding something back). Can be used intransitively in sense 2 (turning back oneself).
